searchText: Can anyone confirm that Infura Ropsten nodes don't currently support `eth_feeHistory`? And if so, does anyone have a node endpoint I can use? Cc <@388751025789468672> I don't think it's been merged in most clients yet. Geth PR is still open (https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/23033). It seems merged in Besu, though: https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/pull/2466 Is there perhaps any public node at the moment that I could play around with `eth_feeHistory`? You can use this Besu node > curl --location --request POST 'http://18.116.30.130:8545/' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-raw '{ > "id": 28, > "jsonrpc": "2.0", > "method": "eth_feeHistory", > "params": [ > 7, > "latest", > [ > 0.0, > 0.0, > 0.0 > ] > ] > }' Amazing! Thanks. are there any nodes with https urls we can use to test?
